title: Engine Controls — Thrust Lever Quadrant — Exchange for the Fluorosilicone Seal and Bonded Clamp Standard
abstract: Exchange of the thrust lever quadrant for one built with a fluorosilicone detent seal and a bonded-face friction clamp, restoring detent feel on aircraft identified by the breakout force measurement.

sections.planning_reason: Quadrant strip-downs on aircraft reporting a soft climb detent consistently find the detent lubricant displaced onto the friction clamp faces and the retaining seal hardened. A detent that cannot be felt is a standardisation problem rather than a control failure, but two operators have raised it through their safety boards and crews on mixed fleets report it as a distraction. Aircraft identified as below the acceptance band by the breakout force measurement will not recover without this change.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin exchanges the throttle quadrant for an assembly built with a fluorosilicone detent seal of revised section and a friction clamp with a bonded facing that is unaffected by the lubricant. The clamp mounting bracket anchor nuts are renewed for the thicker clamp. Quadrants are supplied set up on the bench, so no breakout force adjustment is required at the aircraft.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the engines are shut down and that the aircraft is on ground power with the autothrust disconnected. Get access in zones 211 and 215 and open the centre pedestal. Disconnect the quadrant electrical interface and label every connector. Remove the quadrant complete. Fit the exchange quadrant, which contains the seal ASH79119-70, the friction clamp D7610111733252 and the mounting bracket D7610117147370, and secure it with the anchor nuts AGS837365-4E. Re-connect the electrical interface and check continuity on every circuit. Verify the detent breakout force at the climb gate with the calibrated gauge and confirm that it is inside the acceptance band. Do the thrust lever inspection following task AMM-Z-76-10-11-200-037-A. Close the pedestal and do an autothrust engagement check on the ground. Record the embodiment and return the removed quadrant.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft that have had the breakout force measurement performed and have at least one reading below the acceptance band. The measurement bulletin must have been embodied first.
sections.material_note: Quadrants are supplied on exchange, set up and sealed at the bench. Lead time is quoted at order. The anchor nut set is shipped with the quadrant. Removed quadrants must be returned within thirty days to keep the exchange price.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience once a breakout force reading below the acceptance band has been recorded.

sections.material_note: Quadrants are supplied on exchange, set up and sealed at the bench, with a supplier-confirmed lead time of eighteen weeks and a build rate of forty assemblies a quarter. type_data.compliance_time: Within 12 months of a breakout force reading below the acceptance band, subject to the eighteen week quadrant lead time; aircraft furthest below the band are scheduled first.
